final_assessment: Scope session settling Q-rc04c-c. rc04c is SPLIT (Sal, 2026-09-21) into rc04d-override-vocabulary + rc04c-retire-gate-overridden — the THIRD preventive application of R-crc-9, caught at exploration by a size check before anything was proposed. The check measured gate_overridden across 6 baseline capabilities and 14 requirements, twice R-crc-1's ceiling on the binding dimension; the charter's own scope line had the right instinct and half the work, because rc04a MODIFIED three capabilities without removing the field from any of them.
